description: Pixel Class is a centralized notes-sharing and collaboration platform designed specifically for BCA and MSc-IT students at Shreyarth University. It simplifies access to academic resources by providing notes, assignments, and study materials in one place, eliminating last-minute stress.
problem_it_solves: Students often struggle to find notes, assignments, and important study materials at the last moment, leading to inefficiency and stress.
solution: Provides a single platform where students can easily access, share, and collaborate on academic content in real-time.
unique_value: A focused, university-specific platform that ensures all academic resources are accessible in one place, improving productivity and collaboration.

description: A personal portfolio website to showcase my projects, skills, and experience. The goal is to create a professional online presence to attract potential employers and collaborators.
problem_it_solves: Lack of a centralized platform to display my work and skills to a professional audience.
solution: A modern, responsive, and fast-loading website that effectively communicates my capabilities and professional journey.
unique_value: A highly interactive and visually appealing portfolio that not only lists projects but also tells a story about my growth as a developer.
future_scope: Integrate a headless CMS for blog posts

description: Mechanic Setu is an on-demand roadside assistance platform that connects vehicle owners with nearby verified mechanics in real-time. It enables quick help for issues like flat tires and minor mechanical faults, ensuring convenience and faster resolution.
problem_it_solves: Vehicle owners often face difficulty finding reliable mechanics quickly during roadside emergencies, leading to delays, stress, and safety concerns.
solution: Provides a real-time marketplace that connects users with nearby verified mechanics, enabling fast and reliable roadside assistance.
unique_value: Bridges the gap between vehicle owners and mechanics by creating a fast, reliable, and location-based assistance network.

description: An enterprise-grade ticket management system designed to streamline IT support operations and asset tracking. Built with a modern Vercel-inspired UI, it enables teams to efficiently manage support requests, monitor assets, and improve response workflows.
problem_it_solves: Organizations struggle with unorganized support requests, delayed issue resolution, and lack of proper asset tracking, leading to inefficiency and downtime.
solution: Provides a centralized platform for managing support tickets, tracking IT assets, and improving communication between users and support teams.
unique_value: Combines support ticketing and asset management into a single high-performance system with a modern UI and efficient workflows.
business_context: Developed during an internship at Excellent Publicity as part of IT support operations to improve internal system efficiency.
